answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake tied to one verifiable work history before it can earn. Like a jetty, that stake is a single fixed point of entry: a newcomer proves itself on small, checkable tasks, and only a long record of useful work lets it reach larger jobs, while a plume of fake identities would each need its own stake and its own slow history. Crossing that frozen tundra of waiting time and cost for every clone makes Sybil attacks more expensive than the rewards they could steal.
